errors.evidence: The vertical axis range is from 0 to 40, not 0 to 30 as stated.
The vertical axis is labeled at intervals of 5, not 10.
The categories on the horizontal axis are not ordered alphabetically; they follow a specific sequence based on language families.
Bars in the Semitic group reach up to approximately 30, not 20-25 as stated.
The machine-generated description does not mention the nominal scale of the horizontal axis.
The description omits the specific colors associated with each model (light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red).
The description does not mention the error bars indicating variability within the model effects.
The description does not mention that the Semitic group has the largest error bars across all its bars.
The description does not mention that the Uralic group has bars mostly below 5.
The description does not mention that the IE-Indic group has bars ranging approximately from 17 to 23.
